info.title: dydt Realtime Market Data
info.description: One multiplexed JSON WebSocket. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <key>` on connect, or send {"type":"auth","key":"<key>"} as the first frame (within 5 s). Then send subscribe/unsubscribe frames naming a stream and {"type":"ping"} every 15 s. Close codes: 4401 invalid key, 4402 paid plan required (Free is REST only), 4429 connection limit or monthly message allowance used. Every data message counts toward the monthly allowance; chart_lines, markers, wallet_signals, token_signals and x_posts need the Pro or Scale plan. Events are not replayed after a disconnect.

subscribe_prices.title: Subscribe: Prices & candles
subscribe_prices.summary: Keep a pool chart current with price and candle updates.

close_quote.description: Price close in the quote asset.

market_cap_quote_open.description: Market cap open in the quote asset.

market_cap_quote_high.description: Market cap high in the quote asset.

market_cap_quote_low.description: Market cap low in the quote asset.

market_cap_quote_close.description: Market cap close in the quote asset.

candles.description: The current candle, updated in place until it closes.

subSessionId.description: Echo of the subSessionId you sent.

payload.description: Price events are flat: fields sit at the top level, not under data.

freeze_revoked.description: 1 when the freeze authority is revoked, 0 when not.

dex_paid.description: 1 when a DEX Screener profile was paid for, 0 when not.

bcurve_gain_5m.description: Bonding curve progress gained in the last 5 minutes.

v.description: Volume. One [quote, usd] pair per window, in the order of t.

vb.description: Buy volume. One [quote, usd] pair per window, in the order of t.

vs.description: Sell volume. One [quote, usd] pair per window, in the order of t.

tc.description: Trades. One count per window, in the order of t.

bc.description: Buys. One count per window, in the order of t.

sc.description: Sells. One count per window, in the order of t.

m.description: Distinct traders. One count per window, in the order of t.

bm.description: Distinct buyers. One count per window, in the order of t.

sm.description: Distinct sellers. One count per window, in the order of t.

windowed.description: Windowed metrics in compact columnar form.

momentum.description: Recent surge in price, volume, and trades, 0 to 100.
